heroImage.caption: Chief Editor — The Mirror Jammu Kashmir

body.text: The Mirror Jammu Kashmir is an independent digital media platform dedicated to truth, justice, and human dignity. Our work is rooted in facts, international law, and the lived realities of the people of the historical State of Jammu and Kashmir.

We challenge silence, expose injustice, and amplify voices that are ignored or deliberately suppressed. In an era of disinformation and shrinking civic space, responsible journalism is not a luxury — it is a democratic necessity.

items: Freedom of expression and of the press are essential for a just society
Historical truth and legal obligations cannot be erased by force

body.text: The Mirror Jammu Kashmir will continue to document ground realities, present verified historical facts, and remind states of their responsibilities under international law. We stand with the people — for dignity, equality, and justice.
